_comment: English letter templates; missing keys fall back to Turkish.

subject: This traffic can't go on
body: Every morning I wait for ages at the same junction. Leaving {district} has become an adventure. Can we find a fix?

subject: A park for our kids
body: There is no safe green space for children in {district}. Even a small park would change everything.

subject: Thank you for the parks
body: I decided to write to you during my morning walk in the park. The city feels so much greener.

subject: Jobs are getting scarce
body: Many people around me are looking for work. Do you have a plan for new workplaces?

subject: The night market and our sleep
body: The night market is lovely, but the music until midnight keeps our baby awake. Could there be a time limit?

subject: How are the city's finances?
body: I read the coffers are nearly empty. Wouldn't a little saving help?

subject: You're invited to our street party
body: We're throwing a small party in {district}: music, pastries and good company. We'd love to see you.

subject: The bike lanes are great!
body: I cycle to work now and never wait in traffic. Thank you for the protected lanes!

subject: Taxes are heavy
body: The latest tax rise is hard on small businesses. Could it be reviewed?

subject: A poetry night at the café
body: We'd like to host a monthly poetry and music night at our local café. A little support would mean a lot.

subject: It snowed — what about the roads?
body: The kids are thrilled, but I can't get to work. Will the roads be cleared?

subject: Our metro dream
body: As the city grows, life without a car gets harder. A metro line would change our lives.

subject: Just wanted to say thanks
body: No complaints — I'm simply happy living here. Thank you for your work.

options.promise_park: A park for your area is planned
options.thank_back: Thank you for your kind words
options.explain_growth: Jobs will come as we grow
options.decline_politely: I can't make it this time
options.clear_roads: Send crews to clear the roads (1,500 TL)
options.promise_metro: A metro plan is on my desk

neg: I still can't accept the {policy} decision.

pos: I loved that you answered me last time.
